class.name: InventoryObserverReplicaNode
class.description: Recipient-only projected observer replica. This node accepts only the dedicated inventory-observer-v1/version-1 replacement view protocol and exposes no canonical restore, runtime query, or authority mutation methods.

method.name: apply_delta_bytes
method.description: Applies one exact predecessor full-replacement observer view. Duplicate/stale deltas are successful no-ops; gaps or invalid successors leave the view unchanged and request resync.

method.name: apply_snapshot_bytes
method.description: Atomically installs a dedicated recipient-bound observer baseline. It cannot restore canonical inventory state.

method.name: configure_stream
method.description: Binds the immutable exact recipient, inventory, and observer visibility stream before the first packet. This is local packet binding, not authentication.

method.name: resync_request_bytes
method.description: Returns an ObserverResyncRequest with no visibility authority. The gateway resolves visibility from the authenticated configured recipient/inventory stream policy, including the generation=0/last_applied_sequence=0 bootstrap with no cached view; initialized requests carry the current positive generation and sequence.

method.name: set_catalog
method.description: Assigns the sealed catalog before initialization. The catalog validates projected values but is not a canonical restore target.

method.name: view
method.description: Returns an owned value view. The manifest fingerprint is exposed as a decimal String; redacted content is represented by aggregate-only shells, never hidden item rows.
